# Exact predecessor source snapshots

These files are unchanged copies of the four foreign-head provenance files
previously listed in this package's SOURCES.json. They are retained so a clean
checkout can validate the same source bytes without fetching unrelated fork
branches. They are provenance archives, not additional replay modules.

- `pr3221/PROOF.md` and `pr3221/a3_model.py`: Nick Petalas, PR3221,
  `abfbfefa3e66168f15c5b7415c3aab29d09c59a5`, original directory
  `research/p112-a3-rank-six-shortening/`.
- `pr3227/PROOF.md`: Nick Petalas, PR3227,
  `2a79c8314ae10b677bc7c1dd593d0c3d06b7cd15`, original directory
  `research/p112-a3-six-flat/`.
- `pr3154/CONJECTURES.md`: DreamingOfClouds, PR3154,
  `708f0ad8928c383de8294aea3c126e9461d2066d`, original directory
  `research/p112-reduction-to-conjectures/`.

The original E8/P112 and decoder lineage, including joaqcoo, remains credited
in the source files and package README. Original Git blob IDs and SHA256
hashes remain in SOURCES.json, alongside the original foreign pins. Relative
links inside these verbatim excerpts refer to their original source packages.

All four sources are contributions to CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds under
Apache-2.0. The unchanged repository license is included as LICENSE.
